exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
outcome: Cost per inpatient stay for childbirth
cohort: 11,033 women who gave birth (7,777 vaginal deliveries and 3,256 cesarean sections) at a tertiary hospital in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, in 2016
finding: The cost per inpatient stay for cesarean section was significantly higher than that for vaginal delivery (USD 592 vs. USD 255), highlighting the potential for cost savings by promoting vaginal birth.
mod_finding: The cost per inpatient stay for cesarean section was significantly higher than that for vaginal delivery (USD 592 vs. USD 255).
